description: HX study set part A task hxb1-bakery-flour. Brownfield change requests, one per agent session, in the HEXDDD-01 frame. Behaviour and constraints only; the scored sub-goal and the levers are recorded in README.md, puzzle.json and levels.json, never shown to the agent.

tasks.title: Flour orders when the wholesaler says no

steps.request: Our buyer orders flour from the Sackline wholesaler. The Sackline SDK, the package sackline-sdk, is already in the project and the Sackline client is already created with the token in SACKLINE_TOKEN for the flour list; use the same client. When Sackline answers OUT_OF_STOCK (the depot ran out after the list was loaded), app.order(orderId, sku, bags, deliverOn) must not give an error: it answers status 'sold_out' with alternative, the sku of the cheapest other flour of the same grade that still has at least that many bags in stock, or null when there is none.

The depot also has a minimum order value. When Sackline answers BELOW_MINIMUM with shortfallCents, app.order(orderId, sku, bags, deliverOn) answers status 'too_small' with missing, the amount in euros the order still lacks (null when Sackline does not say). Other Sackline refusals stay errors.

The bakery takes deliveries Monday to Friday only. app.order(orderId, sku, bags, deliverOn) with a deliverOn that falls on a Saturday or a Sunday answers the error 'We take deliveries Monday to Friday only.' and nothing is ordered.
